why: A keyboard Confirm pressed for one screen must not activate the next screen's primary action (issue #919): the arrival now focuses that primary, and Enter and Space activate it natively. With the cancel gone, a held Enter's repeats, the keypress of the keystroke that dismissed Launch, and a Space released after a match all press the new screen.
killedBy: createCarriedConfirmGuard (issue #919) cancels every event of an Enter held across an arrival: repeats, keypress and keyup
createCarriedConfirmGuard (issue #919) cancels every event of a Space held across an arrival: repeats, keypress and keyup
createCarriedConfirmGuard (issue #919) cancels the keypress and keyup of the very keydown that made the arrival
createCarriedConfirmGuard (issue #919) cancels a keydown stamped before the arrival though it is delivered after it (a queued press)

hud: arrival lands on the primary action, and a Confirm from the screen before cannot press it (issue #919) an Enter that opens a pane cannot press its primary with the repeats, keypress or release of that Enter
hud: arrival lands on the primary action, and a Confirm from the screen before cannot press it (issue #919) a Space held through the end of a match cannot press Retry with its repeats or its release
hud: arrival lands on the primary action, and a Confirm from the screen before cannot press it (issue #919) a keydown queued behind an arrival cannot press the new primary
createRouteHost: the keystroke that leaves Launch cannot press the Main Menu (issue #919) cancels the keypress of the Enter that dismissed the splash, so Start Campaign is not pressed
